services.value: Provides chemical and microbial analysis of drinking and surface water resources, wastewater, and industrial or storm runoff. Specific services mentioned include drinking water analysis (bacterial contamination testing, inorganic compounds and metals testing, disinfection byproduct detection and quantification, hardness and other parameters), surface water analysis (e.g., fecal indicator quantification, pseudomonad quantification, nitrogen and phosphorous compounds, pathogen detection), and certified detection and quantification of fecal indicator organisms plus total heterotrophic bacteria counts and pseudomonad quantification.
